caption_word_span_source: PocketSphinx forced word spans; first starts in beats 2 and 3 set to local 0.14 s from unconstrained recognition, and beat 2 as set to local 5.13 s after unconstrained silence. All independently cross-checked with Wav2Vec2 CTC.
uncertainty_note: Typical acoustic boundary uncertainty; not an empirical confidence interval. CTC character spikes fall inside phonemes and are narrower than acoustic word spans. No claim of exact millisecond ground truth.
highlight_rule: Use each absolute words[].start <= time < words[].end. No extra anticipation, lag, gap filling, duration normalization, or end trimming. Ordinary 30 fps sampling applies.
audio_mix_rule: Place each complete original MP3 at its original beat.start; do not trim at uploaded beat.duration. Original beat start offsets remain unchanged. 36 s output includes all speech and tails.
